source_scope: 308 distinct workpoints: frozen 226 plus 40 wider-grid, 34 further-grid, and 8 Bayesian proposals.
order: Proposal/admission stage, never worker completion order. Reused initial controls enter stage 1 but were generated before it; dense probes were proposed together and ran alongside subsequent BO. Restarted workers retain stage 19; restart and completion times do not create extra search stages.
objective_contract: Stages 1-5 used mode-conditioned training with two noise runs; stages 6-12 used one-noise label-free J; stages 13-16 used label-free J and J_joint. Plotted summaries use only topology2511/noise847401 throughout. Stages 17-19 return to the frozen single label-free J, with fixed EE/angle; stage 19 uses completed grid feedback. Stage 20 was not proposed.
missing_legacy_score: Original hand-placed runs saved half-peak first-crossing dense ranks, not full contact envelopes/centroids. Do not assign them current centroid errors or substitute the later local reference.
